claim: Kortrijk's 13th-century Beguinage of Saint Elisabeth has been on the UNESCO World Heritage list since 1998 and features 41 historic houses, an inner courtyard, Saint Matthews Chapel, and a new experience centre in the Sint-Anna room; address Begijnhofstraat 2, 8500 Kortrijk.
quote: The Beguinage has been on the 'UNESCO World Heritage' list since 1998. ... Saint Matthews Chapel ... Sint-Anna room with a new experience center

claim: Kortrijk's Begijnhof Sint-Elisabeth has 41 well-preserved whitewashed houses dating mostly from the 17th century and is considered one of the finest beguinages in Belgium.
quote: The Begijnhof features 41 well-preserved houses, dating back to the 17th century.

claim: Kortrijk 1302, the Battle of the Golden Spurs museum, is open every day 10am–5pm with free admission by reservation, located at Deken Zegerplein 1.
quote: Open every day from 10 am to 5 pm ... Free admission - reservation required ... Deken Zegerplein 1, 8500 Kortrijk

claim: Texture, the museum of flax and textiles, is housed in an authentic 1912 flax depot on the banks of the Leie at Noordstraat 28, Kortrijk.
quote: Texture is a museum of flax and textiles located in an authentic flax depot (1912) on the banks of the River Leie. The museum is located at Noordstraat 28

claim: Texture museum admission is €8 adults, €6 students/seniors, free under 12.
quote: Children (0-12): Free | Adults: €8.00 | Students: €6.00 | Seniors (65+): €6.00

claim: Saint Martin's Church on the Grote Markt is the main Gothic church of Kortrijk, built 1390–1466, with an 83m Brabant-Gothic tower rebuilt in the 19th century after the 1862 fire.
quote: Saint Martin's Church (Dutch: Sint-Maartenskerk) is the main Roman Catholic church and one of the principal Gothic monuments of Kortrijk ... The 83 m high tower in Brabant Gothic style

claim: Visitors can climb the 246 steps to 65m on Saint Martin's church tower for panoramic views over Kortrijk's UNESCO Belfry and Beguinage; open daily 10am–5pm.
quote: climb the 246 steps to a height of 65 meters ... open to the public daily from 10 am to 5 pm

claim: Buda Island, between two arms of the Leie, was reinvented from 2000 onwards as Kortrijk's 'island of arts' and hosts the Buda Tower, BUBOX contemporary visual-arts space and the Buda Factory creative hub.
quote: Buda Island is nestled between the arms of the river Leie and functions as an island for the city's artistic visitors ... The Buda Tower ... BUBOX ... The Buda Factory

claim: The Leieboorden are lowered, landscaped riverbanks with wide promenades, new bridges and parks created when the Leie was widened for navigation, now a central green walking zone.
quote: a facelifted city with a widened Leie, new bridges, banks with wide paths, beautiful parks and restored contact with the water

claim: The twin medieval Broel Towers, remnants of the 14th-century fortifications, flank the Leie and are an iconic Kortrijk landmark especially photogenic when illuminated at night.
quote: The Broel Towers history goes back to the 14th century, once part of Kortrijk's medieval fortifications. These twin medieval towers are one of the city's symbols, and they sit on either side of the Leie River

claim: Brasserie Muze at Grote Markt 3a offers lunch, tea-room dishes and refined seasonal dinners directly on Kortrijk's main square.
quote: Brasserie Muze - Located at Grote Markt 3a in the heart of Kortrijk

claim: Huyze Begga is a café-restaurant inside the UNESCO Beguinage known for breakfast and lunch using local seasonal Belgian ingredients.
quote: Huyze Begga ... renowned for its exceptional breakfast and lunch offerings. The menu is thoughtfully curated to highlight local ingredients and seasonal specialties

claim: Kortrijk SNCB station sits about 400m from the city centre — roughly a 5–6 minute walk to the Grote Markt and 15 minutes to the Leieboorden.
quote: Kortrijk station is located approximately 0.387 kilometers from the city center ... the Grote Markt market square in 6 minutes, and the Leieboorden in 15 minutes

claim: Kortrijk's underground Station car park (three levels, accessed via Stationsstraat) opened recently and offers convenient paid parking adjacent to the station for visitors driving in.
quote: the car park is open 7 days a week with access via Stationsstraat

claim: Kortrijk's Grote Markt is the main square anchored by the medieval Belfry (UNESCO World Heritage) and the City Hall, surrounded by terraces and shops.
quote: The Grote Markt, the Belfry and the City Hall

claim: CRVV is at Markt 43, 9700 Oudenaarde, open daily 10:00-18:00 except Wednesdays (open Wednesdays during school holidays); closed 25/12 and 01/01
quote: Markt 43, 9700 Oudenaarde (Belgium) ... Dagelijks open voor het publiek van 10u tot 18u ... except Wednesdays ... closed December 25 and January 1

claim: CRVV is an experience centre featuring expo on cycling heritage (e.g. Museeuw 30|60), Peloton Café, bike rentals and guided rides on the actual Tour climbs and cobbles
quote: expo dedicated to cycling heritage ... walk through his impressive list of achievements ... Peloton Café ... Bike rentals and guided rides ... heroic narrow winding Flemish roads, short steep climbs and cobblestones

claim: CRVV interactive exhibits let visitors test their Tour knowledge, rotating themes (Queens of the Race, Racing during Cold War), a children's route, and rent professional BMC/Ridley/Specialized bikes to ride the yellow/blue/red Tour loops
quote: test your knowledge about the Tour against the glorious history ... pain of the loser, the euphoria of the winner ... rent professional racing bikes from brands like BMC, Ridley, and Specialized

claim: CRVV pricing: groups (min 15) €5.50/person, schools €2/person, 90-min guided tour €75; brasserie De Flandrien on-site; simulates difficulty of climbs and harshness of cobbles
quote: Groups (minimum 15 people): €5.50 per person ... Schools: €2.00 per person ... Guided tour (90 minutes): €75.00 ... interactive elements simulating the difficulty of climbs and harshness of cobblestone sections ... brasserie called De Flandrien

claim: MOU Museum is in the Stadhuis at Markt 1, 9700 Oudenaarde, showcasing 43 tapestries from Oudenaarde's 16th-century industry and one of Flanders' largest silver collections in late-Gothic chambers from c.1530
quote: Stadhuis, Markt 1 – 9700 Oudenaarde ... Collection of 43 tapestries ... Large collection of silver and other fine metalware ... one of the largest in Flanders ... late Gothic architectural style ... chambers from around 1530

claim: The Oudenaarde belfry tower attached to the town hall (housing the MOU) was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site on 1 December 1999 as part of the Belfries of Belgium and France group listing
quote: The belfry was recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site on December 1, 1999, as part of the group registration of Belfries in Belgium and France

claim: Koppenberg (Melden, Oudenaarde) is a 600 m cobbled climb at 11.6% average and 22% max gradient; first used in the Tour in 1976, infamous for the 1987 Skibby incident, rebuilt in 2002
quote: Height: 77 meters ... Climb length: 600 meters ... Average gradient: 11.6% ... Maximum gradient: 22% ... First included in the Tour of Flanders in 1976 ... 1987 incident involving Danish rider Jesper Skibby ... reopened in 2002

claim: Oude Kwaremont (Kluisbergen) is Flanders' longest cobbled climb at 2.2 km with a café at the summit; Paterberg (361 m, 12% avg, 20% max) lies 13 km from Oudenaarde finish line and has a rainwater gutter for relief
quote: Oude Kwaremont ... 2.5 km semi-cobbled climb ... The Kwaremont café operates at the summit ... Paterberg ... 361m cobbled climb, 12% average (max 20%) ... 60 cm rainwater gutter ... 13 km from Oudenaarde finish line

claim: Peloton Café at CRVV is a pilgrimage stop for cycling fans, steps from the Oude Kwaremont, Paterberg and Koppenberg where one can watch race footage and soak up Flemish cycling heritage
quote: watch race footage, soak up Flemish cycling heritage and sip coffee just steps from the Oude Kwaremont, Paterberg and Koppenberg at Peloton Café – a pilgrimage-worthy stop for every flandrien at heart

claim: Liefmans brewery tours run Mon-Sat at 10:00, 14:00 and 17:00, last 2 hours, cost €16 per visitor and include a guided tour of the original riverside brewery plus two tasting beverages; online booking only
quote: Monday through Saturday at 10 am, 2 pm, and 5 pm ... Duration: 2 hours ... €16 per visitor ... Two beverages (tasting) ... 300+ year-old building ... perfect air to create unique fruit beers

claim: Liefmans Goudenband is a mixed-fermentation reddish-brown beer aged 4-12 months that keeps improving like fine wine even after a decade, brewed on the Scheldt in Oudenaarde
quote: This reddish-brown beer, resulting from mixed fermentation, takes 4 to 12 months to achieve the right level of maturity ... Liefmans Goudenband is a beer for storing, and just keeps improving over the years like a fine wine

claim: De Carillon at Markt 49 is a beer café in two 17th-century gable houses on Oudenaarde's main square (rebuilt 1921 after WWI bombardment) specialising in regional brews like Ename Blonde and Adriaan Brouwer Bruin
quote: Cafe Carillon occupies two small gable houses on Oudenaarde's main square ... destroyed during World War I bombardment ... the interior was reconstructed in 1921 ... features locally-produced options including Ename Blonde and Adriaan Brouwer Bruin

claim: Kasteel Ooidonk interior is open Sundays and public holidays from 2pm-5:30pm between 1 April and 1 November, plus Saturdays 2pm-5:30pm in July and August; adult castle admission is €15 and gardens €4.
quote: From 1 April to & including 1 November on Sundays and public holidays from 2pm to 5.30pm; also on Saturdays from 2pm to 5.30pm in July and August. Adults: €15.00 ... Gardens Adults: €4.00

claim: Ooidonk Castle sits in Bachte-Maria-Leerne near Deinze in East Flanders, about 15-20 km from Beveren-Leie via the Leie valley.
quote: Ooidonk Castle (Dutch: Kasteel van Ooidonk) is located in Bachte-Maria-Leerne, a village in the municipality of Deinze in East Flanders, Belgium.

claim: A traffic-free asphalt Leie towpath runs from Deinze to Kortrijk, prohibited to cars/motorcycles except residents, making it a classic flat ride for cyclists and walkers.
quote: The towpath between Deinze and Kortrijk is considered a classic route ... an asphalt path exclusively for slow traffic, prohibited to cars and motorcycles except for residents.

claim: The F7 cycle highway shadows the Ghent–Kortrijk railway and forms the fastest bike link between Ghent and Kortrijk via Deinze and Waregem, directly serving Beveren-Leie.
quote: De F7 volgt de spoorlijn Gent-Kortrijk en vormt de snelste fietsverbinding tussen Gent en Kortrijk en de tussenliggende steden Deinze en Waregem.

claim: West Flanders' renewed cycling junction network launched Easter 2026 totals 3,700 km and 1,482 numbered junctions (knooppunten), connecting seamlessly to France, Netherlands, East Flanders and Hainaut.
quote: het totaal aantal fietskilometers in de provincie op 3.700 ... het aantal knooppunten is gestegen tot 1.482 ... naadloos aan op de netwerken in Frankrijk, Nederland, Oost-Vlaanderen en Henegouwen.

claim: The West-Flemish network uses ~18,000 signage boards on 13,000 poles and is used by 7.3 million cyclists annually; riders chain junction numbers to build personalised routes.
quote: ongeveer 18.000 signalisatieborden geplaatst op 13.000 palen ... bijna 7,3 miljoen fietsers per jaar

claim: Provinciaal Domein De Gavers in Harelbeke spans 192 ha around a recreation lake roughly 10 km from Beveren-Leie, offering swimming, sailing, surfing, diving, separated walking/cycling/equestrian paths, an arboretum and bird hides, drawing about 800,000 visitors a year.
quote: De Gavers is met 192 ha het grootste natuur- en recreatiedomein van Zuid-West-Vlaanderen ... ongeveer 800.000 bezoekers per jaar

claim: Provinciaal Domein De Brielmeersen in Deinze covers 40 ha between the Leie and the Schipdonk Canal, 100 m from the market square, with walking paths, ponds, animals, sports fields and a yacht harbour, free entry from 8:00-22:00 (Apr-Oct) and until 18:00 in winter.
quote: De Brielmeersen is a provincial domain located in the centre of Deinze between the Lys and the Schipdonk Canal ... only 100 meters from Deinze market and covers 40 hectares.

claim: Sterrebos in Roeselare is a 19th-century star-shaped castle park around Rumbeke Castle with a 200-year-old plane tree and a medieval-themed playground.
quote: all paths radiate from a central point, forming a star ... an impressive plane tree stands tall at over 200 years old ... medieval-style play area

claim: The Flemish Ardennes offer signature hikes such as the 16.6 km Will-o'-the-wisp route through Brakelbos, La Houppe and Bos ter Rijst, and a 22.6 km Flemish Ardennes Challenge over steep slopes near Ronse — Brakel sits about 30-35 km east of Beveren-Leie.
quote: this 16.6 km hike takes you along and across the language border ... exploring Brakelbos, La Houppe, and Bos ter Rijst

claim: Kluisbos in Kluisbergen is the largest forest of the Flemish Ardennes; the signposted Kluisbos walk is ~6 km (with a 3.5 km short option) and climbs the 141 m Kluisberg with panoramic views.
quote: This rather challenging circuit through one of the showpieces of the Flemish Ardennes ... The trail leads over the Kluisberg, one of the most striking witness hills of the Flemish Ardennes with a top of 141 meters

claim: Velo Vainqueur is a cycle shop in Beveren-Leie (Waregem) that rents and sells e-bikes, road bikes, gravel bikes, mountain bikes and children's bikes — the closest rental to Castor.
quote: Velo Vainqueur, fietsenwinkel Beveren-leie (waregem)

claim: Mobiel vzw in Kortrijk rents standard and electric bikes for exploring the Leie banks and the wider Leiestreek.
quote: Bike rental Mobiel | Rental in Kortrijk | Leie region

claim: The 42.2 km signposted Flax-Lys (Vlasleie) cycle route loops from Harelbeke through Beveren-Leie's Zavelput welcome site, threading the area's flax heritage.
quote: Flax Lys cycle route | Guided cycle route ... The Flax Lys cycle route is a guided cycle route of 42.2 km from Harelbeke ... includes the welcome site at the Zavelput in Beveren-Leie.

claim: The Roger Raveelmuseum in Machelen-aan-de-Leie is closed for climate/energy renovation works from 10 February 2025 through end of June 2026.
quote: Het museum sluit de deuren wegens verbouwingswerken van 10 februari 2025 tot eind juni 2026.

claim: The Roger Raveelmuseum's announced reopening date is 28 June 2026.
quote: Heropening 28 juni 2026

claim: Roger Raveelmuseum standard adult ticket is €10, with €2 youth (13-26), €8 seniors/groups, and free entry for under-12s and museum-pass holders; address Gildestraat 2-8, 9870 Machelen-aan-de-Leie.
quote: Standard: €10; Groups (10+), seniors (60+): €8; Youth (13-26): €2; Free: Children under 12, museum pass holders

claim: Mudel (Museum van Deinze en de Leiestreek) opens Tuesday-Friday 14:00-17:30 and Saturday-Sunday 10:00-12:00 and 14:00-17:00, closed Mondays.
quote: Tuesday-Friday: 14 - 17.30 u. Saturday-Sunday: 10 - 12 u. en 14 - 17 u. Closed on Monday

claim: Mudel's permanent collection features Leie-region masters including Constant Permeke, Albert Servaes, Valerius de Saedeleer, Gustave Van de Woestijne, Frits Van den Berghe, Roger Raveel and Raoul De Keyser, spanning realism through expressionism and abstraction.
quote: leading regional artists including Constant Permeke, Albert Servaes, Valerius de Saedeleer, Gustave Van de Woestijne, Frits Van den Berghe, Roger Raveel, and Raoul De Keyser

claim: KOERS Museum of Cycle Racing is at Polenplein 15, 8800 Roeselare, with high-season (Mar-Sep) daily 10am-5pm hours and low-season (Oct-Feb) Mon-Sat 10am-5pm, closed Sundays.
quote: Low Season (Oct-Feb): Mon-Sat 10am-5pm, Sunday closed; High Season (Mar-Sep): Daily 10am-5pm

claim: KOERS Museum admission is €9 for adults 26+, €3 for 19-25, €1 for 4-18, free under 4 and on the first Sunday of each month during high season.
quote: Ages 0-3: Free; Ages 4-18: €1.00; Ages 19-25: €3.00; Ages 26+: €9.00; Free: first Sunday monthly (high season)

claim: KOERS features an interactive journey through cycling history including a 90-degree cobblestone wall, vintage bikes, racing trophies, and the temporary exhibition 'Worldwide Cycling' on view until end of September 2026.
quote: an interactive journey through the history of bicycles and cycling ... 90° cobblestone wall, racing trophies, vintage bikes ... temporary exhibition called 'Worldwide Cycling' on view until the end of September 2026

claim: BE-Part's Waregem location at Gemeenteplein 12, 8790 Waregem opens only during exhibitions, Thursday-Saturday 14:00-17:30 and Sunday 11:00-17:30.
quote: Only open during exhibitions. Thursday—Saturday: 14:00—17:30 Sunday: 11:00—17:30

claim: MUST Museum of Textiles in Ronse (De Biesestraat 2) is housed in the former Cambier-Robette factory with ~40 working looms, visit only by guided tour at 15:00 (Tue-Sun Mar-Sep, weekends/holidays Oct-Nov), Dutch-language only.
quote: former 'Cambier-Robette' textile factory ... some 40 working looms ... The MUST - Museum of Textiles can only be visited with a guide ... Tours offered only in Dutch

claim: The Memorial Museum Passchendaele 1917 in Zonnebeke (Berten Pilstraat 5A) reopens 1 February 2026 with daily 10:00-17:30 hours (last admission 16:30), but lies ~30 km west of Beveren-Leie and is on the edge of the day-trip radius.
quote: After a one-month closure, visitors can discover the story of the First World War at the Passchendaele Museum in Zonnebeke from 1 February 2026 ... open daily from 10 am to 5:30 pm, with last admission at 4:30 pm

claim: Museum Dhondt-Dhaenens in Deurle/Sint-Martens-Latem (Museumlaan 14, ~20 km from Beveren-Leie) shows modern and contemporary art, open Wednesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00, closed Mon-Tue and between exhibitions.
quote: open Wednesday–Sunday, 10:00–17:00 ... closed on Monday, Tuesday, 24-25/12 and 31/12 & 01/01 and during installation of new exhibitions

claim: Brouwerij Omer Vander Ghinste in Bellegem offers guided brewery tours Monday to Sunday for EUR 20 per person, lasting about 2 hours, including a visitor center, beer tasting and initiation in the OMER pouring ritual; advance booking required.
quote: A brewery visit with a guide is possible from Monday to Sunday. The visit costs EUR 20 per person and takes approximately 2 hours. Booking in advance is always necessary.

claim: Omer Vander Ghinste is located at Brouwtorenstraat 5, 8510 Bellegem (a hamlet of Kortrijk), a roughly 15-18 km drive south from Beveren-Leie.
quote: Brouwerij Omer Vander Ghinste, Bellegem, Kortrijk, West Flanders Province

claim: Rodenbach in Roeselare launched a new interactive visitor experience in October 2024; individual guided tours run Wednesday to Sunday at 14:00, with a sound-and-light show inside a giant foeder cask and a tasting in Het Foederhuis.
quote: Rodenbach Brewery launched a brand-new visitor experience in October 2024, featuring an interactive tour... Individual guided tours are available from Wednesday to Sunday at 2 PM.

claim: The Rodenbach Classic guided tour costs EUR 17 for adults and includes one 25 cl Rodenbach beer plus a EUR 5 voucher for the brewery shop; tour duration is around 90 minutes.
quote: The Classic Arrangement Adults guided tour costs EUR 17, and the price includes one Rodenbach beer (25 cl) and a EUR 5 voucher to spend in the brewery shop.

claim: Het Foederhuis cafe at Rodenbach (Spanjestraat 133, 8800 Roeselare) is open Wednesday to Sunday 11:00-19:00, serving food paired with Rodenbach beers in the shade of oak foeders.
quote: Het Foederhuis is located at Spanjestraat 133, 8800 Roeselare... open from Wednesday to Sunday from 11:00 to 19:00.

claim: Brouwerij De Brabandere in Bavikhove (Rijksweg 33, 8531) runs 90-minute brewery tours for EUR 12.50 per person, weekdays only, with a 15-person minimum, ending with a 75 cl special beer; an optional Petrus Sour blending workshop costs EUR 5 extra.
quote: The brewery tour lasts approximately 1.5 hours and costs EUR 12.50 per person... Tours require a minimum of 15 people and operate on weekdays only. The last tour starts at 18h.

claim: De Brabandere brews both the world-class Bavik Super Pils and the foeder-aged Petrus Sour range (Petrus Aged Red, Petrus Roodbruin, Petrus Nitro Quad) under the same roof, alongside the Kwaremont beer.
quote: Petrus Nitro Quad, Petrus Aged Red and Petrus Roodbruin) and some very famous and classics like the Kwaremont and Bavik. It isn't common to hear of a world-class pilsner (Bavik Super Pils) being brewed under the same roof as one of the most sophisticated foeder-ageing sour programs in the world.

claim: Brouwerij Verhaeghe in Vichte (Beukenhofstraat 96, 8570) accepts visits by reservation daily at 10:00 or 14:00 for EUR 10 per adult; the brewery sits 100 m from Vichte train station and produces the Flanders red Duchesse de Bourgogne.
quote: Visits are available on reservation every day at 10:00 or 14:00, and the cost for adults is 10 euros. The brewery is close to the Vichte train station; you only need to cross the street and go 100m further to the right to find the visitor entrance at Beukenhofstraat 96.

claim: Duchesse de Bourgogne is a Flanders red mixed-fermentation ale matured for many months in oak casks; the tannins from the oak give it its fruity character.
quote: Duchesse de Bourgogne is a Flanders Red Ale of mixed fermentation. It is a sweet-fruity ale with a pleasant fresh aftertaste. After the main fermentation and the lagering, the Duchesse de Bourgogne matures further for many months in oak casks.

claim: Filliers Distillery in Deinze (East Flanders, ~25 km east of Beveren-Leie) offers guided distillery tours of 1.5-2 hours in Dutch, French or English daily except Sundays and holidays, with first tour at 09:00 and last at 18:00, covering its jenever, gin and Belgian whisky (Goldlys) production.
quote: Tours take 1.5 to 2 hours (including tasting) and guides in Dutch, French, or English can be provided. Tours take place daily after advance arrangement, except on Sundays and holidays, with the first tour starting at 9:00 am and the last tour at 6:00 pm.

claim: Filliers acquired the Waregem-based lemon-jenever distillery Wortegemsen from Albert Kint in 2009, making it the Belgian market leader in jenever.
quote: In 2009 Filliers took over Wortegemsen - the Waregem-based distillery of lemon jenever - previously owned by Albert Kint.

claim: Waregem hosts a Saturday morning open-air market every Saturday 07:30-13:00 in the city centre with about 50 stalls, plus a smaller Wednesday-afternoon market 14:00-18:00 on Kerkplein Beveren-Leie - within walking distance of Castor.
quote: Elke zaterdagvoormiddag van 7.30u. tot 13.00u... About 50 market stalls... Kerkplein Beveren-Leie: Elke woensdagnamiddag van 14.00u. tot 18.00u.

claim: Kortrijk does not run a Saturday market; the big weekly market is Monday 06:00-14:00 on the Grote Markt, Graanmarkt and surrounding streets, with smaller markets in Bissegem (Tuesday), Rollegem (Wednesday), Overleie (Friday afternoon) and Marke (Sunday morning).
quote: Maandagmarkt: Elke maandag van 06.00 tot 14.00 uur op de Grote Markt, Graanmarkt, Schouwburgplein en Doorniksestraat.

claim: Deinze runs a Wednesday-morning market on the Markt (08:00-12:00) and a Saturday-morning market 08:00-12:00 at Kastanjelaan in Petegem-aan-de-Leie.
quote: Markt Deinze every Wednesday from 8 to 12 o'clock, Kastanjelaan Petegem every Saturday from 8 to 12 o'clock.

claim: Several farm shops are scattered around Waregem and its sub-villages, including Hoeveproducten Haerinck (Harelbekestraat 13, Waregem) for vegetables/dairy/eggs/cheese, Fruit Lambrecht-Baart (Sint-Eloois-Vijve) for apples, pears and juices, and Aardbeien Van Overbeke for strawberries.
quote: Hoeveproducten Haerinck, Harelbekestraat 13, Waregem - Vegetables, dairy, eggs, cheese, preserves. Fruit Lambrecht-Baart, Leiegoeddreef 9, Sint-Eloois-Vijve - Apples, pears, juices, preserves.

claim: Hoeveproducten Haerinck is a family-run mixed dairy and arable farm in Waregem with about 120 dairy cattle; the shop sells own milk, eggs, potatoes and jams plus partner farms' yogurt, cheese and hoeve-ijs (farm ice cream).
quote: Father Christiaan and son David run the mixed farm... mother Christiane and daughter-in-law Lien manage the farm shop... yogurt, cheeses, and hoeve-ijs.

claim: D'Origine is a single-origin artisan chocolatier with an atelier and shop at Moorseelsestraat 78, 8500 Kortrijk and a second shop at Pand 246, 8790 Waregem, offering pralines, seasonal figurines and interactive chocolate workshops in Kortrijk.
quote: Kortrijk: Moorseelsestraat 78, 8500 Kortrijk (atelier and shop). Waregem: Pand 246, 8790 Waregem (shop)... Beyond retail sales, the shop hosts interactive chocolate workshops in Kortrijk.

claim: Bellewaerde Park (Meenseweg 497, 8902 Ieper) opens for the 2026 season on April 4 with tickets valid until October 4 2026; high-season day tickets are €43 (€35 pre-July).
quote: Bellewaerde Park opens on April 4, 2026, and tickets are valid until October 4, 2026. High season tickets for the theme park are €43 per person for adults and children over 1 metre in height, while discounted tickets up to the start of the high season (1st July) are €35 per person.

claim: Bellewaerde is a 54-hectare hybrid theme park and zoo with 300 animals across 36 species, situated near Zonnebeke about 5 km from the centre of Ieper.
quote: Bellewaerde is a hybrid theme park and zoo located at Meenseweg 497 in Ieper, Belgium, spanning 54 hectares and combining thrilling amusement rides with exhibits featuring 300 animals from 36 species.

claim: Bellewaerde Aquapark sits beside the theme park at Meenseweg 497, 8902 Ieper and is open year-round (typical hours 10:00-20:00 in season).
quote: Meenseweg 497, 8902 Ieper, België ... Open vandaag 10:00 - 20:00

claim: Waregem Koerse 2026 — the annual hindernisrennen highlight — takes place on Tuesday 1 September 2026 at the Gaverbeekhippodroom, headlined by the ING Grote Steeple-Chase van Vlaanderen (16:25, €100,000) and the UAE President Cup (17:05, €250,000).
quote: 1 September 2026 ... ING Grote Steeple-Chase van Vlaanderen ... 16:25 ... €100,000 ... UAE President Cup ... 17:05 ... €250,000

claim: The Gaverbeekhippodroom in Waregem is 17 ha just outside the town centre; the famous Gaverbeek obstacle is 7.5 m wide — the widest brook in the world — and the day puts €361,000 in prize money on the line across eight races.
quote: De Gaverbeekhippodroom is 17 hectare groot ... Voor de acht koersen die op die dag plaatsvinden, is er een totale prijzenpot van 361.000 euro ... met 7,5 meter de breedste beek ter wereld.

claim: Beyond the September showcase, the Gaverbeekhippodroom hosts trotting and gallop races almost every weekend from early May to September, with the 2026 season opener (Openingskoerse KUB Koercheval) on Friday 1 May.
quote: vrijdag 1 mei de Openingskoerse draf en galop (KUB Koercheval) op de Gaverbeekhippodroom

claim: Cascata in Waregem is a luxury private spa rented exclusively to one party, with Finnish sauna, indoor pool, hammam, jacuzzi, bio-sauna and garden; three-hour duo slots from €200 last-minute.
quote: Cascata biedt onder andere de Finse sauna, een ruim binnenzwembad, hammam, jacuzzi, biosauna met aromatische geuren, verkwikkende regendouches, een sfeervolle relaxruimte en een prachtige tuin.

claim: D-Hotel in Waregem offers an in-house wellness area with spa pool and loungers for guests.
quote: The d-hotel features a spa pool where guests can relax in luxurious loungers.

claim: HEIUKI runs a self-service stand-up paddle and kayak rental station on Buda Island, Kortrijk, putting paddlers onto the Leie past the Broeltowers.
quote: HEIUKI operates a new kayak rental station at Buda Island in Kortrijk offering a flexible, staff-free outdoor experience on the River Leie.

claim: Dobber rents kayaks and SUPs at Buda-eiland in Kortrijk daily from April through October, departing the Reepkaai past the Budatowers and Broeltorens.
quote: Dobber ... open daily from April to October ... depart from the Reepkaai and paddle past the Budatowers, the College Bridge and the medieval Broeltowers.

claim: Max 20 20 rents self-drive boats from Port de Vive (Leiesas 1, 8790 Waregem) — roughly 3-4 km from Castor — giving direct Leie access toward Sint-Martens-Latem.
quote: Max 20 20 offers boat rentals with a base at Port de Vive parking (Leiesas 1, 8790 Waregem) from where you can easily travel to Sint-Martens-Latem
